## What changes

## Both clients

Orca has two screens on one core (see `docs/parity.md`). For a new feature:

- [ ] API entry (`src/ipc/api.ts`) and handler
- [ ] Core behavior + contract test (`tests/contract/`)
- [ ] Shared model/actions (browser-safe) if both screens show it
- [ ] Terminal UI
- [ ] Mac app (`packages/mac`)
- [ ] Row in `docs/parity.md`
- [ ] Commands, palette, menu bar, help
